design_philosophy: Functional brutalism meets high-end fintech. Prioritizes data density, extreme contrast for legibility, and technical precision. Uses a 'Control Room' grid system where every pixel serves the data.

layout.spacing_system: Dense. p-4 to p-6 for internal card padding, gap-4 to gap-6 for grids.
layout.page_structure: Top navigation bar (glassmorphism over dark bg), followed by a 4-column metric card grid, followed by a full-width data table.

grid_classes.main: flex flex-col gap-6 p-6 md:p-8 max-w-[1600px] mx-auto

cards.style: bg-[#1e293b] border border-slate-700/50 rounded-lg shadow-sm flex flex-col justify-between p-5

table.header: bg-slate-900/50 text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-slate-400 font-semibold border-y border-slate-700/50 py-3 px-4
table.cell: py-4 px-4 text-sm align-middle whitespace-nowrap text-slate-300
table.ticker_cell: font-mono font-medium text-slate-100 bg-slate-800/80 px-2 py-1 rounded

buttons.primary: bg-indigo-500 hover:bg-indigo-600 text-white font-medium rounded-md px-4 py-2 transition-all shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(99,102,241,0.2)] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(99,102,241,0.4)] flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.action: bg-transparent border border-slate-600 text-slate-300 hover:text-white hover:border-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-800 rounded px-3 py-1.5 text-xs transition-all font-medium
buttons.disabled: opacity-50 cursor-not-allowed border-slate-700 text-slate-500 hover:bg-transparent hover:border-slate-700 hover:text-slate-500

badges.base: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider border shadow-sm

side_panel.wrapper: fixed inset-y-0 right-0 w-full md:w-[450px] bg-[#0f172a] border-l border-slate-800 shadow-2xl z-50 transform transition-transform duration-300 flex flex-col
side_panel.overlay: fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm z-40 transition-opacity

inputs.base: w-full bg-slate-900 border border-slate-700 rounded-md px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-200 placeholder-slate-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 transition-all
inputs.label: block text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 mb-1.5

status_animation.description: When 'Process' is clicked, badge changes to 'Processing' with a pulse animation. After 3 seconds, transitions to 'Completed'.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on rows and buttons should have a 150ms-200ms ease transition.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast against background meets minimum 4.5:1 WCAG AA standards. Form labels must be clearly associated with inputs.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements must include a kebab-cased `data-testid` attribute.

implementation_instructions.2: Include fonts in index.css: Work Sans (Headings), IBM Plex Sans (Body), JetBrains Mono (Tickers/Data).
implementation_instructions.3: Use Shadcn UI (Table, Dialog/Sheet, Button, Badge, Input, Select, Form, Card). Override default Shadcn styles to match the dense, dark '#0f172a' fintech aesthetic.
implementation_instructions.4: Seed the initial table state with 8-10 mock corporate actions (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, TSLA, META, NVDA, JPM). Use standard action types (Dividend, Stock Split, Merger, Rights Issue).
implementation_instructions.5: Implement the Action Processor side panel. Submit triggers an Alpha Vantage API call to fetch the company name (`https://www.alphavantage.co/query?function=SYMBOL_SEARCH&keywords={TICKER}&apikey=demo`). If the API fails or is rate-limited, fallback gracefully to a mock company name to ensure the MVP works.
implementation_instructions.6: Add the newly submitted action to the table immediately as 'Pending'.
implementation_instructions.7: Process Button Logic: In the table row, clicking 'Process' changes the item state to 'Processing' (blue badge, pulsing). Start a 3000ms timeout, then change to 'Completed' (green badge). Make the button disabled during processing and after completion.
implementation_instructions.8: Top Impact Summary Cards must use derived state from the table data to automatically update (Total Actions, Pending Count, Affected Securities, Avg Processing Time).
implementation_instructions.9: Add rigorous test attributes to all elements (e.g., `data-testid="process-action-btn"`, `data-testid="status-badge-pending"`, `data-testid="action-processor-form"`, `data-testid="ticker-input"`).
